Assets = Liabilities + Owner's equity.

手書きの会計

＿＿ software records and processes transactions.
Internal control
内部統制

Rules and checks that protect assets and keep records accurate.
Petty cash
小口現金

少額の支払いのために手元に置く現金。

Economics
経済学
The study of how people use limited resources to satisfy unlimited wants.
限られた資源で限りない欲求をどう満たすかを学ぶ学問。
The study of how people use limited resources to satisfy unlimited wants.

資源は限られているのに欲求は限りないという基本的な問題。
The basic economic problem: resources are limited but wants are unlimited.
Opportunity cost
機会費用

何かを選んだときにあきらめた、次に良い選択肢。
The next best alternative given up when a choice is made.
Three economic questions
3つの経済問題

What to produce, how to produce, and for whom to produce.

生産要素

土地・労働・資本・起業家精神。
Land, labour, capital and entrepreneurship.

生産要素への報酬
Rent (land), wages (labour), interest (capital), profit (entrepreneur).

Rent (land), wages (labour), interest (capital), profit (entrepreneur).
Entrepreneur
起業家
A person who takes risks to bring resources together to start a business.
リスクをとって資源を集め、事業を始める人。
A person who takes risks to bring resources together to start a business.
Traditional economy
伝統経済

慣習や伝統にもとづいて決める経済。
Decisions are based on custom and ＿＿.

政府が主な経済の決定をし、資源の多くを持つ経済。
The government makes the main ＿＿ decisions and owns most resources.

市場経済

Decisions are made by buyers and sellers through prices; resources are privately owned.

市場・計画・伝統の特徴を合わせた経済。フィジーがその例。
Combines market, command and traditional features; Fiji is an example.
Demand
需要
The quantity of a good buyers are willing and able to buy at each price.
それぞれの価格で買い手が買いたい、買える量。
The quantity of a good buyers are willing and able to buy at each price.
Law of demand
需要の法則
When price rises, quantity demanded falls (and the reverse).
価格が上がると需要量は減る（逆も同じ）。
When price rises, quantity ＿＿ falls (and the reverse).
Supply
供給
The quantity sellers are willing and able to offer at each price.
それぞれの価格で売り手が売りたい、売れる量。
The quantity sellers are willing and able to offer at each price.
Law of supply
供給の法則
When price rises, quantity supplied rises.
価格が上がると供給量は増える。
When price rises, quantity ＿＿ rises.
Equilibrium
均衡
The price where quantity demanded equals quantity supplied.
需要量と供給量が等しくなる価格。
The price where quantity demanded equals quantity supplied.
Surplus
超過供給（余り）

供給が需要より多い状態。ふつう価格が高すぎるため。
Supply is greater than demand, usually because the price is too high.

品不足

需要が供給より多い状態。ふつう価格が安すぎるため。
Demand is greater than supply, usually because the price is too low.

需要に影響する要因

Income, tastes, prices of related goods, population, advertising, season.
Central government
中央政府

学校・病院・防衛などを担う国の政府。
The national ＿＿ that provides services such as schools, hospitals and defence.
Local government
地方自治体

ごみ収集や公園など地域のサービスを担う町や市の議会。
Town and city councils that provide ＿＿ services such as garbage collection and parks.

不動産の持ち主が地方自治体に払う税金。
Taxes paid by property owners to the local council.
Government revenue
政府の歳入

政府の歳出

A general and continuous rise in prices.
Unemployment

People who are able and willing to work but cannot find jobs.

The total value of goods and services ＿＿ in a country in a year.

国と国の間で商品やサービスを売り買いすること。
Buying and selling goods and services between countries.

輸出／輸入

Goods and services sold to / bought from other countries.

形のある商品の取引。

貿易外取引（サービスの取引）

＿＿ in services, e.g. tourism, shipping, insurance.

貿易収支

モノの輸出 − モノの輸入。
Visible exports − visible imports.

経常収支
Visible and invisible exports minus visible and invisible imports.
モノとサービスの輸出 − モノとサービスの輸入。
Visible and invisible exports minus visible and invisible imports.

資本収支

Improvement in people's living standards, not only income growth.

Measures such as life expectancy, literacy rate, income per person and access to clean water.

Measures such as life expectancy, literacy rate, income per person and access to clean water.

Tourism Fiji

The government body that promotes ＿＿ as a ＿＿ destination.
